events.description: 6. ** TEXT ONLY ORDER ** The United States of America has filed suit against the Wisconsin Elections Commission and several individuals. The court calls attention to three things to which plaintiff must attend. First, pursuant to the court's electronic filing procedures, plaintiff must promptly complete and file summons so the clerk may issue them in the normal course. Second, the motion to compel, Dkt. 2, which plaintiff filed along with the complaint, autogenerated a response deadline. But defendants have not yet been served with summons, so the court strikes that deadline, to be reset upon defendants entering the case. Third, this case was randomly assigned to Magistrate Judge Anita Marie Boor. To ensure all parties promptly consent to or request reassignment from Judge Boor, plaintiff is reminded to serve all standard attachments issued on December 18, 2025, including the consent form, on defendants with the summons and complaint. Signed by Magistrate Judge Anita Marie Boor on 12/19/2025. (acd) (Entered: 12/19/2025)

events.description: 32. ** TEXT ONLY ORDER ** Plaintiff has submitted executed summons, Dkt. 26, indicating service was completed on December 30, 2025, and counsel has entered an appearance for defendants, Dkt. 27 . Applying Rule 12, defendants' deadline to answer or otherwise respond to the complaint is January 20, 2026, absent some agreement, order, or other exception. Also, proposed intervenors have submitted a notice reporting that the parties take no position on their proposed intervention. Dkt. 31 . In light of these developments, the court ORDERS the following: No later than January 20, 2026, plaintiff and defendants must file letters confirming their position on the proposed intervention. The deadline to respond to the motion to compel, Dkt. 2, is RESET to January 27, 2026, and any reply is due February 3, 2026. Signed by Magistrate Judge Anita Marie Boor on 1/8/26.
